summary: Hertz Vehicle Financing III LLC, a bankruptcy-remote subsidiary of The Hertz Corp, issued two series of asset-backed notes (Series 2026-3 and 2026-4) totaling $834.75 million to third parties, plus Class E notes retained by Hertz. This 8-K reports entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. The transaction is a routine securitization financing, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. Terms are standard for rental car ABS offerings. No unusual structural features or strategic implications are indicated; the filing is operational debt financing.
